instruction: Send the draft I wrote to Marco.
final_text:
I sent your draft to Marco Bianchi (marco@verdant.example) as a reply in the "Renewal pricing" thread. It said:

> Hi Marco, we can't do 20%, but we can offer 10% on a two-year commitment. Let me know if that works. Best, Sam

Before sending, I checked that Marco hadn't written again since his message yesterday asking for 20% off. He hadn't, so your reply still fit the conversation. I sent it exactly as you wrote it.

Your other draft, "Pilot scope" to Priya Shah, hasn't been sent.
